content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**What changed on re-review:** the frequency element is now carried by an affirmative, expressly-capped formulation — "Such audit shall occur no more than once per Calendar Year," — replacing the blank "[***] in a given Calendar Year, unless for cause," so the annual limit reads as a cap on its face rather than as a negated blank with a for-cause escape.

**Final position (AUDIT — deviation, fallback target):**
1. §9.9(a) notice: "at least fifteen (15) days' prior notice".
2. §9.9(a) frequency: "shall occur no more than once per Calendar Year" (for-cause exception deleted).
3. §9.9(c) cost shift: underpayment "more than ten percent (10%)".

All three fallback elements are in operative language; independent auditor (9.9(a)) and auditor confidentiality (9.9(d)) were already met and untouched; the look-back/waiver sentence, mutual scope and Article XI overlay are preserved.
